test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different position of the same dice are shown, having letters H, I, J, K, L and M written on its faces are shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c852c5f9214373e6314d1c997c7d0e6331fbf5bf1dd4dc5f9aeb64a43cb88ec.png] 

Which letter is on the face opposite to the face having H on it?
solution:
When we observe both the figures we see:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c16a6770362d9b21fd7c70dd46fb584ebb664edcba1da3d2dce2e7ae792fea1d.png] 

The dice is turned having L on the same positions which means H, I, J, K are the four sides of the dice.

L →L

J → K

H → I

Now when the dice is rotated H comes at the place of I and J comes at the place of K which means **H is opposite to I.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**
